meta.plant_name: Evergy Kansas Central 2025 IRP power station 5

units.notes: This plant has no real site. It is a placeholder for capacity in the Evergy Kansas Central plan update of May 2025, so no location, city or coordinates were researched. The 2044 date lies beyond the end of both public plan decks, which stop at 2034 and 2035, so no public document confirms the 440 MW block. Only the note on the US IRPs tab of the Update sheet lists it.

qa.recommendation: The announced step is the May 2025 plan update, per the note on the US IRPs tab, which lists this block for 2044. The public May 2025 deck ends at 2034 and does not show it. A full plan document or a Kansas Corporation Commission filing was not found. Not found beyond that tab note.
qa.note: Searched the Evergy investor decks and the Kansas Corporation Commission records already gathered, plus one web search.
